parameters.question: Identify genes with significantly different mutation frequencies between tumor and matched normal samples using Fisher's exact test and return top 10 hits. The 10 gene records must match the reference; frequencies and odds ratio must match within 1% relative absolute error; p-value must match within +/-0.001; row order, column order, and header labels may differ.

Count columns use RAE with cell_tolerance=0 for exact integer matching. Frequency, difference, and odds ratio columns use RAE with cell_tolerance=0.01 to enforce the 1% relative absolute error requirement. P_Value uses RAE with cell_tolerance=None because its wide dynamic range makes a single relative tolerance unsuitable for the absolute +/-0.001 requirement. No categorical columns are present, so exact/overlap strategies and delimiters are not applicable.
